# UFMG's Quarto Template for Writing Monographs, Dissertations and Thesis

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->


Before using the template for the first time, make sure the following packages are installed:

```{r}
#| eval: false

pkgs <- c("rmarkdown", "ggplot2", "broom", "kableExtra", "tinytex")
install.packages(pkgs)
```


Installing [tinytex](https://yihui.org/tinytex/) from R:

```{r}
#| eval: false

tinytex::install_tinytex()
```
